summary: A property required INSIDE an optional nested body object is checked only when a flag of that object group was passed (nestedFlagGroupChanged), so bare `settings update` flags, `conduyt-auth logout`, `screen-share delete-session-code <code>` and the other generated commands with optional nested objects are not refused locally; `conduyt-auth logout` keeps running bare (no help guard) and `--marks-drew 0` / `--screen-share-marks-drew 0` are sent.
reason: Printing Press 4.28.0 turns every nested `required` into an always-required flag. On the full public document that made `conduyt-auth logout` and `screen-share delete-session-code` unusable without screen-share flags the API does not require, and `settings update` required 19 nested flags.
validated_outcome: Bare delete-session-code and logout send no nested object; one flag of a group without its required sibling is refused before any request; a full group sends drew 0. TestNestedRequiredFlagsOnlyWhenTheObjectIsSent.
upstream_issue: To file against mvanhorn/cli-printing-press: a nested required list applies only when its parent object is present; int fields of a nested object are sent when Changed, not when non-zero.
